production.note: US model years. First: Acura's 2002 brochure introduces "the next great sports coupe from Acura, the 2002 RSX" with the Type-S at "200 @ 7400 rpm". Last: the latest Acura specification sheet found is for the 2006 RSX/RSX Type-S (acura-rsx-2006-specs, dated September 1, 2005); no opened Acura page says in so many words that 2006 was the last model year.

body.note: Acura calls it a "sports coupe" ("the next great sports coupe from Acura, the 2002 RSX"). A three-door liftback coupe, classed as Coupe like the Integra Type R (DC2).

displacementL.note: 1,998 cc ('Displacement: 122.1 cu. in. (1998 cc)'); same on the 2004 and 2006 sheets.

aspiration.note: Inferred: 'Induction System: Programmed Fuel Injection (PGM-FI)'; no turbocharger or supercharger is listed.

transmission.note: Type-S column: '6-speed manual' only (the base RSX offered a 5-speed manual or 5-speed automatic). The 2002 brochure (acura-rsx-2002-brochure) and the 2004 and 2006 sheets also list only the 6-speed manual for the Type-S.

powerHp.note: 2003 model. Quote: "| Horsepower, SAE Net | 160 hp @ 6500 rpm | 200 hp @ 7400 rpm |" (second column RSX, third column Type-S). The same 200 hp is in the 2002 brochure ("Horsepower: 200 @ 7400 rpm", acura-rsx-2002-brochure) and on the 2004 sheet ("200 hp @ 7400 rpm", acura-rsx-2004-specs), so it covered 2002 to 2004, three of the five model years. The 2005 update raised the rating; the 2006 sheet gives "201hp @ 7800 rpm SAE Net (Rev 8/04)" under the revised SAE procedure (acura-rsx-2006-specs). No Acura page for the 2005 model was opened, so its rating is not given here.

weightLb.note: Type-S, 6-speed manual (its only transmission), 2003 model. Quote: "| Curb Weight | M/T 2721 lbs. (1234 kg) A/T 2789 lbs. (1256 kg) | 2778 lbs. (1260 kg) |" (third column Type-S). The 2004 sheet repeats "2778 lbs. (1260 kg)" (acura-rsx-2004-specs); the 2006 sheet gives "2840 lbs. (1288 kg)" (acura-rsx-2006-specs). No Acura weight for the 2002 model was found, so the reference year is 2003, the first year with a manufacturer figure under the 200 hp rating.

sources.publisher: Acura (brochure hosted by the Auto History Preservation Society)
sources.title: 2002 Acura RSX brochure, pages 1-4
Review: 2002 Acura RSX Type S (Carey Russ)

discrepancies.reason: Model year and source. Acura gives 2,778 lb for the 2003 and 2004 Type-S and 2,840 lb for the 2006 car (after the 2005 update). The Auto Channel's 2002 review panel gives "Curb Weight | 2767 lbs." for a 2002 Type-S; it is a single publication, not a manufacturer figure.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Acura's 2,778 lb because the reference model year is 2003.
